svg.title: The two-tile mechanism of Lemma 11
svg.desc: Panel a: the terrace 4, 6, 2, 1, 5, 3 of the integers modulo 7; its differences 2, 3, 6, 4, 5, 1 are all nonzero residues. Panel b: lifted to the 28-site cycle and cut into two two-tiles, it gives four rows. Each first row is a whole terrace round closed by the gap 7; each second row is the next round without its steps 3 and 2, closed through two zero sites by the gaps 3, 7, 2. Every row has the gaps 1 to 7.

text.tspan: Two two-tiles give all four rows on
